# Test fixtures

`bundled-rules.adventure.json` is a small adventure for testing spells and classes that a built-in catalog doesn't have. It bundles the first-level magic-user spell `ember_dart` (one mode, `dart`) and the first-level cleric spell `lantern_ward` (mode `mend`, reversed form "Lantern Snuff" with mode `snuff`). Its town is Tallow End, and its one dungeon, `cellar`, has a single level with the entrance in `cellar_stair`, then `wine_racks` and `cold_larder`, with no monsters. An adventure document can't bundle a class, so `hedge-mage.character.json` is a level 2 character of the custom magic-user-list class `hedge_mage` (name "Hedge Mage", levels 1 to 3, slots `[1]`, `[2]`, `[2, 1]`) with `sleep` in the spell book, and `cleric-level-2.character.json` is a level 2 cleric, because a level 1 cleric has no spell slots. Import both with `POST /v1/characters/import` (a referee key is required) and pass the returned IDs to `POST /v1/sessions`.
